events.title: DUNGEON AUTOMATA IS IN STEAM NEXT FEST!
events.summary: Hey future golems! We’re thrilled to share that the demo for Dungeon Automata is being featured in Next Fest this week and we are really looking forward to reaching even more players. We recently hit the incredible milestone of 70,000 wishlists and are so grateful to every one of you who have hit that little wishlist button to support the game. It may seem like a small action but it really does help. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794881/fc7a051ec17c2425272d9ed12101f78dca9761ba.png Whatever your thoughts

events.title: Demo Hotfix #1
events.summary: Hey Golems! Thank you all so much for your continued support and enthusiasm with the demo! We're releasing a small hotfix just now that should fix the issue with background music playing incorrectly. Keep all the feedback coming & feel free to join our growing Discord community of fellow Golems! Huge thanks from your friendly neighbourhood Community Manager, Paige

events.title: A Hello and a Thank You!
events.summary: Hello! I am Iizuka from Medium-Rare Games, the developer of Dungeon Automata. For those of you who have recently discovered this game, I would like to take a moment to introduce myself. I hope you will stay with me for a bit! First, I want to clarify that although I operate under the studio name Medium-Rare Games, the actual development is carried out almost entirely by me alone. events.title: Tune in for a fun night in at the Big Break Showcase!
events.summary: Hey everyone! We’re super excited to be part of the Big Break Showcase, hosted by our friends at Coffee Stain and alongside a huge number of other really cool indie games. The Showcase goes live at 6pm CEST, and you can watch it here: We hope you tune in to show support for Dungeon Automata, and you might even see some other games you like too! Thank you so much for the amazing reception to the demo so far, we’ve been really enjoying reading all your feedback. Many thanks, Team Dungeon Automata

events.title: Partnership Announcement & Demo!
events.summary: Hey everyone! I have some exciting news to share today. For some time, I have alluded to big things happening in the background, and I can finally unveil that Medium-Rare Games and Kakehashi Games are teaming up with Raw Fury – the top ranked indie publisher on Metacritic. Together with Raw Fury, we aim to give more players across the world an opportunity to play Algolemeth... or Dungeon Automata as it also will be called! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794881/922e68e23c0c6e57a4955dff2563d1c706c7a81f.png

I’d like to reflect on this year’s activities and share my greetings with you all. (You can find the 2024 report here.)First, a quick introduction for those who are new! events.summary: Hello, everyone. Today, we’re letting you know that Algolemeth’s release date has been formally delayed to 2026. We’re extremely grateful for your continued support and enthusiasm, and apologize for any frustration this news may cause.About the SituationFor context, I have been developing Algolemeth in my free time alongside my full-time day job, and up until now, neither project interfered with the other. events.summary: Hi, I’m @gunzee2, the developer of Algolemeth. We’re thrilled to announce that Algolemeth will be playable at “BitSummit the 13th” in Kyoto next week!▸ Event OverviewDatesBusiness Day: Friday, July 18, 2025Public Days: Saturday–Sunday, July 19–20, 2025LocationKyoto International Exhibition Hall (Miyako Messe) – 3rd Floor, GYAAR Studio BoothThe GYAAR Studio area will feature our fellow contest title “Summer Road” in a festive summer-festival layout—complete with a raffle where you can win prizes!

events.title: Big Announcement! Legendary Composer Yuzo Koshiro to Compose Algolemeth's BGM!
events.summary: 🎉 Big Announcement! 🎉 The BGM for the fully-automated dungeon RPG Algolemeth will be composed by none other than the legendary Yuzo Koshiro, known for his work on many classic titles! All tracks in this game are created using Sega Genesis-style FM synthesis. This hot, retro-inspired sound will energize both your dungeon exploration and strategic battles! events.title: The release of Algolemeth has been postponed to 2025.
events.summary: We regret to inform you that the release of 'Algolemeth' has been postponed from 2024 to 2025.
